input.parentMessage: Help me think more deeply about offering the two books without turning reading into a test.

recentTurns.text: My child likes choosing bedtime books. I want to follow that interest.
You could offer two familiar books and let your child choose. This is a suggestion, not something the family has tried.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Build on the two-book idea and explain how choice, connection and shared attention could help, without testing or claiming that the family already tried it. One coherent structured answer.
